summary: Pharming Group N.V. furnished a Form 6-K on September 22, 2026, attaching a press release announcing that a late-breaking abstract with positive Phase II topline data for leniolisib in genetically identifiable primary immunodeficiencies with immune dysregulation was accepted at the ESID 2026 biennial meeting, held October 14-17 in the Netherlands. The single-arm, open-label, intra-patient dose-escalation study enrolled 13 subjects, showing a mean 26.4% spleen volume reduction and no new safety signals. Pharming expects Phase II CVID topline results in Q4 2026. No transaction, stake, price, or board recommendation is involved; this is a routine clinical-data disclosure, not a special situation.
